items.title: General Electric (GE) Stock May Look Reasonable Following Rare Earth Supply News
items.summary: General Electric has delivered a powerful run over the past few years, and yet the key issue for anyone looking at the stock today is whether its current price lines up with the cash it can realistically generate. With the business tied into everything from aircraft engines to gas turbines, the question is how much of that future cash flow is already baked into a share price around US$320.
